notes: Modified cash basis village, FYE 9/30/2023. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p5); business-type lines from the modified cash proprietary funds statement Total column (p7), which ties to the Statement of Activities business-type figures (expenses 185,465, charges 192,419, interest 1,802, sale proceeds 598, transfers 20,978; p2-3). business_type measure cash (modified cash basis; net position = cash, certificates of deposit and restricted cash, as in FY2024); proprietary cash flows left null as in FY2024 (non-GAAP). Fund balances from p5; beginning cash not printed (null); ending cash = cash and cash equivalents + county treasurer cash (p4), certificates of deposit as investments. Balance sheet: governmental funds balance sheet (p4; totals equal the government-wide Statement of Net Position p1) plus proprietary statement of net position (p6); totals from p1. Detail: General Fund from the departments combining schedule (p10-11, one line per department column); Street Fund and the Water, Sewer and Solid Waste funds from their fund columns on p5 and p7 (no own schedules). The all-funds budgetary comparison schedule (p9) is not recorded (combined, less detailed). Read pages 1-11 of 11
